brief: Community platform stack — Circle/Skool-class, payments, automation, content, member directory.

slots.tagline: Server-rendered community pages with dynamic member routes and auth-gated content.
slots.f1Body: Every cohort and lesson gets its own fast, cached URL automatically.
slots.f2Body: Fetch member data directly from Supabase without client-side bloat.
slots.f3Body: Build webhooks for Stripe and n8n right inside the same codebase.

slots.tagline: Postgres database, realtime subscriptions, and row-level security for member access.
slots.f1Body: Members see only their own billing history and profile records.
slots.f2Body: Live member presence and activity feed updates without polling.
slots.f3Body: Magic-link signup that drops users straight into the community dashboard.

slots.tagline: Subscription tiers, invoicing, and webhook-driven access provisioning for members.
slots.f1Body: Free, Pro, and Elite plans with automatic gating via Supabase hooks.
slots.f2Body: Self-service billing management reduces support tickets by half.
slots.f3Body: Instantly unlock courses when payment clears through n8n automation.

slots.tagline: Visual automation that enrolls members, sends alerts, and syncs data across tools.
slots.f1Body: Drag-and-drop nodes connect Stripe webhooks to Notion databases.
slots.f2Body: Route new signups to onboarding or upsell sequences based on tier.
slots.f3Body: Retry failed invites automatically and log every step for debugging.

slots.tagline: Centralized curriculum, SOPs, and member resources synced to the platform.
slots.f1Body: Curriculum modules link to lessons, tasks, and member progress views.
slots.f2Body: Publish gated content that mirrors inside the Next.js community app.
slots.f3Body: Pull latest docs into the member dashboard every hour via n8n.

slots.tagline: Zero-config CI/CD, preview deployments, and edge functions for global speed.
slots.f1Body: Every push to main ships the platform in under sixty seconds.
slots.f2Body: Run auth checks and geolocation at the closest node to the member.
slots.f3Body: Test new community features on live URLs before merging to production.

slots.ctaBody: This exact architecture powers cohort-based platforms with thousands of paying members. Deploy yours this week.
